objective: Correct the CPVS raw-SNR diagnostic's object-level formula aggregation and input duplicate/overlap accounting on a branch based on current main, without downloading raw archives or changing production selection.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: Required separate approximate, exact and inverse-error two-band results; explicit duplicate/overlap accounting; per-stratum reporting; and a cost gate for >11.2 GB archive processing.

Inspected the raw-SNR script and tests. The script computed all three per-band formulas but used only approximate SNR for the two-band candidate set and confusion matrix. The branch has 80 commits and 14 files and is not based on current main.
Independent artifact-level membership arithmetic and fixed sample strata were rechecked in Session 07. No fresh raw g/r SNR or MGPR result is claimed.

change.scope: Port only the CPVS membership raw-SNR diagnostic and its synthetic tests to a fresh current-main branch. Add separate two-band candidate sets and confusion summaries for approximate, exact and inverse-error formulas; add within-file duplicate and pairwise cross-file overlap accounting; fail closed on within-file duplicates.
change.rationale: The old stacked branch is stale, and its current two-band result hides the differences between formula alternatives. Input overlap and duplicate counts must be explicit before a costly raw scan.

expected_improvement: Explicit per-band and two-band PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN states
Pairwise cross-file overlap counts and hashes
Reproducible compact output with pinned input hashes

regression_protection_count.before: The diagnostic derived a two-band candidate set from approximate SNR only; within-file duplicates and pairwise cross-file overlaps were not reported.
regression_protection_count.after: The code defines separate approximate, exact and inverse-error two-band candidate states; reports within-file duplicates and pairwise cross-file overlaps; lists candidate-only rows with UNKNOWN in any formula; exports formula-specific TSV states; and writes a compact integrity-failure report before fail-closed exit. Three additional synthetic regression functions were added. Current-head CI remains pending.

scientific_validity.after: No raw archive scan or MGPR execution is included in this code-only cycle. Synthetic tests do not establish source-backed scientific validity.

measurement.trade_off: This change improves the diagnostic contract but does not run the >11.2 GB raw archive scan. Synthetic CI does not establish source-backed scientific validity.

evidence: New branch created from main SHA f681408fae8d8062dd72ff74791872c1590f6ee8.
Only the raw-SNR diagnostic script and its synthetic test module have been ported; the old branch's automatic multi-gigabyte workflow was not copied.
The script now emits separate approximate, exact and inverse-error two-band results and explicit within-file duplicate/cross-file overlap accounting.

Three additional synthetic regression test functions are now included: formula-specific two-band membership/confusion results; within-file duplicate and pairwise cross-file overlap reporting; and input-failure evidence persistence. The existing end-to-end fixture asserts expected overlap accounting and zero within-file duplicates. Current-head CI remains pending.
validation.blocker: Fresh Ruff format/lint, focused synthetic tests, full CI, lifecycle validation and review are required. Raw g/r archive scans and MGPR are not run in this cycle.

root_causes: The old script calculated all three per-band SNR variants but build_object_rows and summarize_group derived only one two-band candidate set from approximate SNR.
The input loader merged repeated SourceIDs across input files but did not report within-file duplicates or pairwise cross-file overlaps.
unresolved: Current-head CI has not yet validated the ported script and new tests.
No raw archive scan has been run on this branch.
The 11,602 candidate-only membership discrepancy remains unresolved.
The exact publisher selection method and MGPR result remain unknown.

findings: Per-band formula alternatives must remain separate through the object-level two-band membership calculation.
Cross-file overlap is expected for stratified diagnostic samples; within-file duplicate IDs are a separate integrity defect.
The inverse-error alternative must be labelled diagnostic, not physical SNR equivalence.

open_blockers: Run current-head focused tests and full CI.
Verify formula-specific PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN and confusion counts with synthetic cases.
Verify within-file duplicate detection and pairwise overlap hashes/counts.

knowledge_carried_forward: Branch is based on current main and intentionally excludes the old PR #265 stack.
No raw g/r archive downloads are triggered by this branch.
No CPVS selector, threshold, source ID, model, feature, taxonomy, benchmark or baseline change is made.
Raw source-backed execution requires separate explicit compute/cost approval.
Input-integrity failures must be persisted as compact evidence before fail-closed exit; do not discard duplicate/overlap findings when refusing the raw scan.
